column1: # comment: "Cross-cutting version-set alignments. VersionMembership is a reified relator with no direct flat equivalent; role claims project lossily to schema:version / doap:revision on the member entity."

column6: A DOAP Project is the lineage/container for releases; GMEOW's VersionSet is a more general information-object lineage that also covers books, datasets, emails, etc.

W3C SemWeb Vocab Status vs:term_status annotates a vocabulary term with its maturity (stable/unstable/testing/deprecated/archaic) — the canonical status vocabulary used by FOAF, Dublin Core, etc. GMEOW's termStability is the direct dogfooded counterpart (stable/experimental/deprecated); vs: uses literal status values while GMEOW reifies them as gmeow:TermStability individuals, hence closeMatch rather than exactMatch.
DOAP revision is the flat version string on a software release; GMEOW's versionLabel generalises this to all entity kinds.
schema:version is a flat literal on the versioned entity; GMEOW keeps versionLabel as a general designation across all entity kinds.
